mapper.sql: select s.id, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.version, s.subscription_name, s.event_type_id, t.event_type, t.event_name, s.subscriber_application, s.target_topic, s.data_status = 1 as enabled, s.description from evt_event_subscription s join evt_event_type t on t.id = s.event_type_id and t.del_flag = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from evt_event_subscription where event_type_id = #{eventTypeId} and del_flag = 0
where s.del_flag = 0 and s.data_status = 1 order by s.subscription_name, s.id
